generations.name: First generation, about 60 kWh pack
generations.notes: First-generation e6 with the roughly 60-61 kWh LFP pack (US version planned in 2011 with 60 kWh). EPA range 196-204 km for MY2012-2014. Sold in the US to fleets only (about US$52,000; under 100 imported by Feb 2016). Confidence: low (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BYD_e6

generations.name: First generation, about 80 kWh pack
generations.notes: Same body, larger roughly 80-82 kWh LFP pack (Wikipedia lists 61 or 80 kWh for the first generation, 80-82 kWh "as of 2016"). The EPA range jumps from 204 km (MY2014) to 301 km (MY2016) and the motor listing changes, which fits a pack change at MY2016. EPA rows MY2016-2018 and 2020. Fleet-only in the US. The pack boundary is inferred from EPA ranges, not confirmed on a page. Confidence: low (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BYD_e6
